activity_statements.statement: issues and services consumer credit cards across 26 distinct products including travel rewards (Venture), cash back (Quicksilver), and student cards to over 100 million customers
acquired Discover Financial in 2024-2025, adding the Discover card network to its consumer credit portfolio
operates a fully cloud-based technology infrastructure after closing its last on-premises data center in 2021
builds proprietary AI and machine learning systems for fraud detection, risk management, and customer experience across its banking products
provides consumer auto loans and deposit accounts in addition to credit card services
operates a commercial banking segment serving mid-market and large corporate clients
contributes to 100+ open-source projects and runs internal engineering programs developing AI tools including agentic car-buying assistance

name_reality_gap: Capital One markets itself as a bank but activity evidence shows it is primarily a technology company that runs one of the most sophisticated AI and cloud engineering organizations in financial services — it closed its last data center in 2021 and builds its own proprietary AI infrastructure. It is closer in operational profile to a tech firm that happens to hold a bank charter than to a traditional bank.
